proposition: Ibn Ḥajar reports that after Akhlāṭī's death his house was found to hold a golden cup, flagons of wine, priests' clothes, a Bible, books of philosophy, astrology and geomancy and a chest of precious stones, and that his refusal to attend Friday prayers exposed him to charges of Shiʿism.

mediation.note: a Mamluk chronicler writing about a rumoured mahdi after his death; MK uses it to illustrate boundary-crossing
